description: Inventory the mobile-forensic structures inside an iOS full file-system tar without extracting it: core databases, their WAL/SHM companions, Biome/SEGB, unified logs, keychain, photos metadata and app-container mappings. The tar (plain, gzip, bzip2 or xz) is followed header by header beside the tar library: it is complete only when its end-of-archive block came and the members the library listed are the headers counted.
covers: The paths, sizes and archive timestamps of mobile-forensic structures in one iOS full file-system tar, plus SQLite companion presence. Member names are kept as the archive spelled them (path_b64 is the exact bytes), every occurrence of a duplicated name is its own row with its position, and a database that occurs twice keeps both sizes. A database family is found by its suffix or as the file a -wal, -shm or -journal belongs to, and each occurrence has its type (a link has the size 0 and is not an empty database); a database with neither a suffix nor a companion is not found by name. A tar cut short, ended by a header the library refuses, or holding an extended header too large to read is partial, with where. A run never writes over an earlier run's output. It extracts nothing, parses no artifact content, decrypts no protected data and does not claim that a listed path contains responsive records.
